purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Kolda

queries.query: Kolda Senegal cadastral map parcels official land registry
queries.result: First-party results identified Senegal's DGID as the fiscal/domain/cadastre custodian, its Kolda Centre des Services Fiscaux, the official Géo Sénégal geospatial portal, and the public ONDDL SIG geospatial catalog. No public Kolda parcel layer was found.

queries.query: Kolda Sénégal cadastre parcelles carte officielle service public foncier
queries.result: Les résultats officiels ont confirmé le Centre des Services Fiscaux de Kolda et le Bureau du Cadastre relevant de la DGID, ainsi que les services géographiques publics Géo Sénégal et ONDDL SIG. Aucun service public anonyme de parcelles de Kolda n'a été trouvé.

registryEvidence.custodian: Direction Générale des Impôts et des Domaines (DGID), Centre des Services Fiscaux de Kolda, Bureau du Cadastre.
registryEvidence.locality: DGID's official directory lists CSF Kolda at Quartier Sikolo, Kolda; its NICAD procedure states that the territorial Bureau du Cadastre manages cadastral identification and issues cadastral plan extracts.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes a local cadastral custodian and official procedures, not anonymous public parcel-data availability, citywide coverage, currentness or legal title coverage.

parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:4326 observed on public ONDDL WFS administrative layers
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: A Kolda-area BBOX request against geonode:departement returned one administrative MultiPolygon feature (feature id departement.1); it was not a parcel and was not retained.
parcelDiscovery.note: The ONDDL WFS GetCapabilities listed only regional/departmental and GADM administrative layers, with no parcel/cadastre layer. Géo Sénégal's Kolda page offered ANAT 1:200,000 KML/SHP topographic downloads, not parcel geometry. No safe native parcel identity plus full parcel geometry was available anonymously.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official DGID page retrieved; identifies DGID as the ministry service responsible for fiscal, domain and cadastral matters and lists CSF Kolda.
Official NICAD procedure retrieved; identifies the territorial Bureau du Cadastre as issuer/manager of cadastral identification and plan extracts. No parcel API exposed.
Official Géo Sénégal Kolda page retrieved; exposes ANAT 1:200,000 KML/SHP topographic downloads only, not cadastral parcels.
Official ONDDL SIG public catalog retrieved; public geospatial portal available without login.
Public catalog API returned nine Senegal administrative datasets; none was a parcel/cadastre layer.
Public WFS capabilities retrieved; listed administrative layers including geonode:departement, EPSG:4326, and no parcel layer.
Bounded request returned one department MultiPolygon administrative feature; no parcel identity or parcel geometry.
Route redirected to ArcGIS REST login; no login attempted and no data used.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point [12.8934851754938, -14.9369263744723] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point parcel query was possible.

No parcel layer in the inspected public catalogs or WFS is not evidence of citywide parcel absence; coverage may be private, unpublished, incomplete or available only through an official request/procedure.
The public WFS BBOX response was an administrative department geometry, not a cadastral parcel, so no GeoJSON sample was retained and no native parcel identity was inferred.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS exception was used.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
